description: This PHP class 'EmployeeCsvImportController' manages employee CSV import functionality within the HRM system. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component with properties like allowed file types and maximum file size, likely for importing employee data.

classes.name: EmployeeCsvImportController
